title: Merge configuration layers transactionally
instruction: Implement merge_layers as a transactional deep merge with precedence defaults < file_config < env_config while preserving its API. Inputs must be acyclic dictionaries with string keys. Recursively merge dictionary values; every non-dictionary value, including lists, replaces the lower layer. A value of None deletes that key at its current nesting level. Return a fully independent deep copy: no mutable object may be shared with any input, and inputs must never change. Detect cycles and all invalid nested dictionary keys before producing a result, raising ValueError without mutating anything. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-2 configuration lineage with nested deletion, alias isolation, validation, and cycle handling.
